root:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Analyze and publish OSM polygons carrying website tags.

Options:
  --version             Print the package version and exit.
  -v, --verbose         More log detail on stderr; -vv shows DEBUG.  [default: 0]
  -q, --quiet           Only errors on stderr, and no progress output.
  --debug               Show full tracebacks (also: OSM_PWT_DEBUG=1).
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the
                        installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  init                        Initialise a new run directory.
  extract                     Extract one source PBF.
  analyze-results             Run the analyzer.
  build-card                  Build the artifact-derived dataset card.
  verify-results              Verify a run without mutating it.
  refresh-card                Rebuild the local H3 map/card and migrate its completion receipt.
  finalize-run                Finalize a verified run.
  finalize-snapshot           Finalize a user-frozen snapshot without website enrichment.
  publish-plan                List the publication plan.
  publish                     Publish or dry-run a complete dataset.
  release-stats               Publish only the dataset card and the statistics report.
  create-repo                 Create the Hugging Face dataset repository (dry run unless --apply).
  card-stats                  Recompute and print dataset-card statistics.
  geometry-stats              Recompute and print polygon geometry statistics for a run.
  publish-trackio             Preview or publish metrics for one finalized dataset snapshot.
  run-all                     Run or resume the complete PBF inventory.
  detect-languages            Detect GlotLID languages for every completed text shard.
  segment-sentences           Segment website text into sentences for every language-complete...
  grid5000-prepare            Prepare one data-root, offline Grid'5000 language bundle.
  grid5000-run                Run one staged bundle on a reserved node without network access.
  grid5000-sync               Synchronize one Grid'5000 result into the canonical run.
  grid5000-prepare-sentences  Prepare one data-root, offline Grid'5000 sentence bundle.
  grid5000-run-sentences      Segment one staged sentence bundle on a reserved node, offline.
  grid5000-sync-sentences     Synchronize one sentence receipt into the canonical run.

commands.analyze-results:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag analyze-results [OPTIONS]

  Run the analyzer.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.build-card:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag build-card [OPTIONS]

  Build the artifact-derived dataset card.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.card-stats:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag card-stats [OPTIONS]

  Recompute and print dataset-card statistics.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.create-repo:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag create-repo [OPTIONS]

  Create the Hugging Face dataset repository (dry run unless --apply).

Options:
  --repo-id <str>  Hugging Face dataset repository to create.  [required]
  --exist-ok       Succeed if the repository already exists.
  --apply          Create it; without this, only report the plan.
  --help           Show this message and exit.

  Example: osm-polygon-website-tag create-repo --repo-id owner/name --apply
commands.detect-languages:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag detect-languages [OPTIONS]

  Detect GlotLID languages for every completed text shard.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>               Existing run directory.  [required]
  --batch-rows <int>             Rows processed per language checkpoint batch.  [default: 512]
  --time-budget-seconds <float>  Stop cleanly after this detection budget.
  --help                         Show this message and exit.
commands.extract:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag extract [OPTIONS] {pbf_path}

  Extract one source PBF.

Arguments:
  pbf_path  Source .osm.pbf file.  [required]

Options:
  --run-dir <path>             Existing run directory.  [required]
  --area-workers <int>         Bounded geometry workers for this PBF.  [default: 4]
  --max-in-flight-areas <int>  Maximum queued area payloads for this PBF.  [default: 32]
  --help                       Show this message and exit.

  Example: osm-polygon-website-tag extract region.osm.pbf --run-dir
  "${OSM_POLY_DATA_DIR:-./data}/runs/website-v1"
commands.finalize-run:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag finalize-run [OPTIONS]

  Finalize a verified run.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.

Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag finalize-snapshot [OPTIONS]

  Finalize a user-frozen snapshot without website enrichment.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.geometry-stats:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag geometry-stats [OPTIONS]

  Recompute and print polygon geometry statistics for a run.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.grid5000-prepare:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag grid5000-prepare [OPTIONS]

  Prepare one data-root, offline Grid'5000 language bundle.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>             Existing run directory.  [required]
  --bundle-dir <path>          Grid'5000 bundle directory.  [required]
  --model-path <path>          Verified pinned GlotLID model binary.  [required]
  --commit <str>               Repository commit recorded in the bundle.  [required]
  --shard <str>                Optional source shard basename to stage.
  --time-budget-seconds <int>  Detection budget within the 30-minute job.  [default: 1500]
  --batch-rows <int>           Rows processed per language checkpoint batch.  [default: 256]
  --help                       Show this message and exit.

  Example: osm-polygon-website-tag grid5000-prepare --run-dir <run> --bundle-dir <bundle> --model-
  path <model_v3.bin> --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
commands.grid5000-prepare-sentences:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag grid5000-prepare-sentences [OPTIONS]

  Prepare one data-root, offline Grid'5000 sentence bundle.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>             Existing run directory.  [required]
  --bundle-dir <path>          Grid'5000 bundle directory.  [required]
  --model-dir <path>           Locally staged SaT model directory.  [required]
  --model-revision <str>       Pinned Hugging Face revision of the SaT model.  [required]
  --commit <str>               Repository commit recorded in the bundle.  [required]
  --time-budget-seconds <int>  Segmentation budget within the job.  [default: 1500]
  --batch-rows <int>           Rows processed per sentence checkpoint batch.  [default: 256]
  --max-rows <int>             Row budget packed into one bundle.  [default: 20000]
  --help                       Show this message and exit.
commands.grid5000-run:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag grid5000-run [OPTIONS]

  Run one staged bundle on a reserved node without network access.

Options:
  --bundle-dir <path>            Grid'5000 bundle directory.  [required]
  --time-budget-seconds <float>  Optional override within the bundle limit.
  --batch-rows <int>             Optional override for checkpoint batch size.
  --job-id <str>                 Scheduler job id recorded in the receipt.
  --help                         Show this message and exit.
commands.grid5000-run-sentences:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag grid5000-run-sentences [OPTIONS]

Options:
  --bundle-dir <path>            Grid'5000 bundle directory.  [required]

  --batch-rows <int>             Optional override for checkpoint batch size.
  --job-id <str>                 Scheduler job id recorded in the receipt.
  --help                         Show this message and exit.

Options:

Options:
  --bundle-dir <path>  Grid'5000 bundle directory.  [required]
  --run-dir <path>     Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help               Show this message and exit.
commands.init:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag init [OPTIONS]

  Initialise a new run directory.

Options:
  --output-root <path>      Writable directory holding one run per --run-id.  [required]
  --source-root <path>      Read-only directory of source .osm.pbf files.  [required]
  --expected-source <path>  Expected source PBF path; repeat once per source.  [required]
  --run-id <str>            Run directory name [default: generated].
  --help                    Show this message and exit.

  Example: osm-polygon-website-tag init --source-root /path/to/pbf-root --output-root
  "${OSM_POLY_DATA_DIR:-./data}/runs" --run-id website-v1
commands.publish:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag publish [OPTIONS]

  Publish or dry-run a complete dataset.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --repo-id <str>   Hugging Face dataset repository (defaults to HF_DATASET_REPO).
  --apply           Actually upload (default: dry-run).
  --help            Show this message and exit.

  Example: osm-polygon-website-tag publish --run-dir "${OSM_POLY_DATA_DIR:-./data}/runs/website-v1"
  --apply
commands.publish-plan:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag publish-plan [OPTIONS]

  List the publication plan.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --repo-id <str>   Hugging Face dataset repository (defaults to HF_DATASET_REPO).
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.publish-trackio:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag publish-trackio [OPTIONS]

  Preview or publish metrics for one finalized dataset snapshot.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>      Existing run directory.  [required]
  --space-id <str>      Public Hugging Face Trackio Space.  [default: NoeFlandre/osm-polygon-
                        website-tag-metrics]
  --project <str>       Trackio project name.  [default: osm-polygon-website-tag]
  --dataset-repo <str>  Dataset repository represented by the metrics (defaults to HF_DATASET_REPO).
  --apply               Actually create/update the public Trackio Space.
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.refresh-card:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag refresh-card [OPTIONS]

  Rebuild the local H3 map/card and migrate its completion receipt.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.release-stats:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag release-stats [OPTIONS]

  Publish only the dataset card and the statistics report.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>      Existing run directory.  [required]
  --confirm-repo <str>  Exact dataset repository confirmation.  [required]
  --repo-id <str>       Canonical release dataset repository.  [default: NoeFlandre/osm-polygon-
                        website-tag]
  --apply               Publish and verify (default: dry-run).
  --help                Show this message and exit.

  Example: osm-polygon-website-tag release-stats --run-dir
  "${OSM_POLY_DATA_DIR:-./data}/runs/website-v1"
commands.run-all:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag run-all [OPTIONS]

  Run or resume the complete PBF inventory.

Options:
  --source-root <path>          Read-only directory of source .osm.pbf files.  [required]
  --output-root <path>          Writable directory holding one run per --run-id.  [required]
  --run-id <str>                Run directory name under --output-root.  [required]
  --repo-id <str>               Hugging Face dataset repository (defaults to HF_DATASET_REPO).
  --apply                       Upload after each PBF and at completion.
  --ensure-repo                 Create the HF dataset repo if needed (only with --apply).
  --area-workers <int>          Bounded geometry workers per PBF.  [default: 4]
  --max-in-flight-areas <int>   Maximum queued area payloads per PBF.  [default: 32]
  --fetch-workers <int>         Bounded concurrent URL fetch workers.  [default: 8]
  --host-concurrency <int>      Maximum simultaneous requests to one website host.  [env var:
                                OSM_PWT_HOST_CONCURRENCY; default: 2]
  --host-delay-seconds <float>  Minimum seconds between request starts to one website host.  [env
                                var: OSM_PWT_HOST_DELAY_SECONDS; default: 0.2]
  --detect-languages            Run the opt-in GlotLID language stage.
  --help                        Show this message and exit.

  Example: osm-polygon-website-tag run-all --source-root /path/to/pbf-root --output-root
  "${OSM_POLY_DATA_DIR:-./data}/runs" --run-id website-v1
commands.segment-sentences:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag segment-sentences [OPTIONS]

  Segment website text into sentences for every language-complete shard.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>               Existing run directory.  [required]
  --model-dir <path>             Locally staged SaT model directory.  [required]
  --model-revision <str>         Pinned Hugging Face revision of the SaT model.  [required]
  --batch-rows <int>             Rows processed per sentence checkpoint batch.  [default: 256]
  --time-budget-seconds <float>  Stop cleanly after this segmentation budget.
  --help                         Show this message and exit.
commands.verify-results:
Usage: osm-polygon-website-tag verify-results [OPTIONS]

  Verify a run without mutating it.

Options:
  --run-dir <path>  Existing run directory.  [required]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
